speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of your eyes and skin; this suggests jaundice. To determine the cause, have you noticed if the baby is feeding well, passing stool normally, or if the yellowing appeared within the first 24 hours of life?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Physiologic).

Thank you for the details; the weight gain is reassuring and the onset at two weeks fits the breastfeeding pattern. I will order a blood test to confirm the bilirubin levels and rule out hemolysis. REQUEST TEST: Total_Bilirubin, Direct_Bilirubin, Hemoglobin, Reticulocyte_Count.
